title: Leaving Louisville for the Rabbit's Foot and other minstrel shows
summary: At 16 or 17 a drummer friend got him onto minstrel shows, including the Rabbit's Foot in Mississippi; he cannot pin down the other show.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I guess I was around... About... 16 or 17... I... I... Went out on the...

And... I... I... Went out on the... And... I... I... I... I... I... I... I... I... I... Went out on... A friend of mine was a drummer... He'd been... Went out on the road with those... Ministral bands... Oh yes... And so he... Taught me into going with the... Ministral bands... So I went with the... Ministral bands there...
That must have been back in... 17... 16... 17... Remember whose show it was? Uh... One... I was with two of them... I think it was... They called... One... Rabbit's Foot... Oh yeah...
The Rabbit's Foot... That went down south... Yeah... That's right... That's right...
Down near New Orleans... That's right... I left... Left Louisville and went to... Join them in... Mississippi...
Yeah... That's where they... Worked down in there... And then... What was the name of this other one? A.G. Allen... I believe it was...
Not A.G. Allen... I don't know... A.G. Fields... Was that the big... No... Was Al...
Well that's alright... Don't worry... No... It wasn't Allen... What was the name of that...
Well I know... Rabbit's Foot was one...
Yeah... There must have been a lot of those...
Yeah... And then there was... This fellow that had the band there... It was Mark... He was from St. Louis... Clanness... He had a good band too...
